actual_tool_parameters.prompt:
Create a NEW complete full-body drawing of adult Bunny from head to shoe soles, white portrait composition about 1024x1536. Every pixel of the final image is freshly drawn Japanese anime ink + clean hard cel color, not a patched or pasted edit.
REFERENCE 1 current jacket figure is the authority for pose, head/body proportions, slim waist/long legs, chest/hips, white shirt, red shorts, high-low orange jacket, every glove/device/sock/shoe and all their positions. Preserve this full-body layout and garment dimensions. 
REFERENCE 2 is the current same-view BASE HEAD, sole authority for facial identity/hair/eyes/line color: continuous cool-gray silver-white hair shadow groups, deep ink, blue eyes and restrained peach skin; no extra fractured white strands, cyan eyes, cloudy/oily skin or texture.
REFERENCE 3 is the harness alone, STRUCTURE ONLY. Its hardware and continuous strap topology stay unchanged; wear this harness OUTSIDE the WHITE TOP but INSIDE the ORANGE JACKET. This changes layer order, not harness design. ORANGE jacket fabric and RED lapels are opaque and IN FRONT of all covered harness portions. Do not make them transparent, open holes, lift them, shorten hems or relocate hardware to display hidden parts. 
REFERENCE 4 is accepted lower hardware and BELT placement only: black belt goes through original red pants belt loops, covering original pants button naturally; no floating bare-belly belt. Same two front orange anchor covers, two rear black sewn anchors, four total silver hooks/rings split 2 front/2 back. Front waist clasp BLACK, chest clasp SILVER. Each visible strap end joins exactly one compact swivel hook then one waist ring; not chain links or extra fittings.
Keep normal open black fine-rib collar, cuffs with fine ribs, small official white connected OG on left sleeve pocket with generous unchanged margin, all screens/UI and handedness unchanged. No helmet/weapon. Matte charcoal straps, sparse hard black shadows; 2-3 hard tones for metal, no chrome airbrush. Clean clothing interior colors and edge context; no random white flecks or mottling. No labels.
FRONT ORTHOGRAPHIC VIEW. Jacket covers both shoulder straps at the shoulders; NO black band or gold adjuster on orange shoulders, orange front panels, or red lapel faces. Gold shoulder adjusters are underneath and may be entirely invisible; do not move them to the chest.
Inside the existing central jacket opening, slim inner portions of the two vertical straps may be seen on the WHITE shirt near opening edges. The RED lapels overlap and hide their outer portions. A SINGLE underbust black ring crosses only the exposed WHITE shirt with ONE silver clasp centered, at the same underbust height as the standalone harness; its left/right ends disappear behind the opaque lapels. NO high crossband at upper chest and no backside hardware through torso.
Below the unchanged jacket front tips, two short black tails emerge from underneath the garment and connect through two silver hooks to two orange front belt anchors. Do not redraw tails over the orange jacket hem surface. Keep exposed waist, original white shirt length and front-long jacket tips. Belt at the pants waistband; center black clasp hides silver pants button.

method: builtin imagegen; complete fresh drawing; byte-exact native; lossless WebP only
